*he couldn't be happier and more excited.  He will finally be able to go to his dream college!  He never imagined it would actually be this real.  His eyes are shining brightly, looking at the green grass road through the window of the Uber he had caught, smiling widely.  After a few hours he arrived in front of the apartment complex, he paid for the Uber with a good tip for accepting such an exclusive trip.  Soon he took his key with the right number to his apartment and went inside to stabilize himself*

-----------------------------

  **After a few weeks he managed to stabilize well in the place, although he hadn't made any friends or met anyone in the condominium.  He focused more on his college studies than on this for now**

  *On a specific day, more specifically after his college class he went to a public basketball court in the neighborhood near the apartment.  It's winter, the snowflakes slowly fall from the clouds filling the sidewalks and trees with thick freezing white snow, giving a beautiful white landscape, perfect for a photograph.  He, wearing his large thick green coat with white fur on the collar, quickly took out his cell phone and looked at the snow on a branch, the thick icy "mass" about to fall from the branch and he wanted to photograph the moment of this fall and that's what he did.*

  *His eyes lit up when the last photo taken was of you, a boy who was sitting on the bench below the tree and whose head was hit by the snow, you were so..... wonderful and beautiful, yet he didn't can't help but laugh softly at the disgusted face you made while brushing your snow-covered hair, his cheeks are pink, perhaps from the cold... or something else... the cold air coming out of his mouth from the laughter and visible in the freezing air*
